row.evidence: Productboard's pricing table lists 'SCIM user provisioning' as Not available on Free, Plus and Business and Included on Enterprise (Custom, 5 makers minimum), and SCIM requires SAML SSO, which is also Enterprise-only.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Pricing changed since June: the single Spark tier at $15/maker/mo is gone; the page now lists Free ($0), Plus ($19/maker/mo annual, $25 monthly), Business ($59/maker/mo annual, $75 monthly) and Enterprise (Custom, 5 makers minimum). June's '~$350/maker/mo est.' for Enterprise has no first-party source and was dropped. SCIM 2.0 at https://api.productboard.com/scim/v2 needs SAML SSO configured first; it creates, updates, deactivates and reactivates members (no deletion) and fully manages teams as groups. Okta's catalog app provisions natively; Entra needs a non-gallery app until Microsoft approves the SCIM gallery app. The public API (all plans) only reads members but manages teams.

plans.notes: One pricing view says 2 makers minimum, another says 5 makers minimum (see conflicts).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit logs included; no audit-log API documented.

auth.token_source: Profile menu > Integrations > Public API > generate Access token (or OAuth2; Okta uses 'Authenticate with Productboard' OAuth)

endpoints.notes: ServiceProviderConfig and ResourceTypes metadata are returned via GET /Schemas; separate endpoints not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Member is deactivated (active=false), not deleted; users cannot be deleted via SCIM.

attributes.notes: Productboard stores only full name; name.* and emails in responses are parsed from Name and Email.

roles.how: Multivalued 'roles' attribute; only the primary (or first) value is used. Values: admin, maker, contributor, viewer; default contributor. Okta maps roles.^[primary==true].value per user or per group.

limitations.text: Users cannot be deleted via SCIM, only deactivated.
Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID are listed as supported IdPs; Entra needs a non-gallery app because the SCIM gallery app is still awaiting Microsoft approval.
Name and Email are shared across workspaces, so SCIM updates to them apply in every workspace the user belongs to.
Once SCIM-provisioned, members and teams are no longer editable in Productboard.
Requires SAML SSO configured first; Okta must use the catalog app, not a custom SAML app.

capabilities.notes: API v2 Members endpoints are read-only (list, search, get); member create/deactivate only via SCIM. Teams have full CRUD and membership patch.

endpoints.purpose: Search members (batch by IDs or emails)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event types cover features, components, products, initiatives, objectives, releases, notes and insights; no member events listed.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are an Enterprise feature on the pricing page; no audit-log API endpoint found in the v2 reference index.

rate_limits.text: 50 requests per second per access token

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO with JIT only; SCIM is set up through a non-gallery app pending Microsoft approval.

google.notes: Productboard help centre has 'Enforce SAML single sign-on with Google Workspace'; Google catalogue page not checked.
